title: RentGuard Renters Policy — Multi-Policy Discount Stop Charge
content:
## Rule

When the last live Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy or Larkspur Valuables Floater of the customer ends during the renters term, the multi-policy discount on the RentGuard Renters Policy stops and the renters policy owes a discount-stop charge, posted as one additional premium entry with change reason multi-policy discount change dated the closed date of the ending qualifying policy.

A live policy is one that is bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal. The charge arises when the customer's Larkspur portfolio no longer holds any live Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy or Larkspur Valuables Floater and the one that ended last did so inside the current renters term.

| Business fact on the records | Effect on the RentGuard premium account |
|---|---|
| Last live umbrella or floater of the customer shows a closed date inside the renters term | One additional premium entry, change reason multi-policy discount change, dated that closed date |
| The charge is posted | The premium balance rises by the charge and the policy's annual premium is restated to the premium after the stop |

## Posting reference: `post_discount_stop_charge_d8b9b7f1`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool posts the multi-policy discount stop on one RentGuard renters policy. One call records a single additional premium entry on the policy's premium account with the reason multi-policy discount change, dated the effective date given, for the amount given; it raises the policy's premium balance by that amount and restates the policy's annual premium to the figure given.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` naming `post_discount_stop_charge_d8b9b7f1`, then calls it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool` with the arguments below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `renters_policy_id` | Reference number of the RentGuard renters policy record being charged, as returned by the renters policy lookup for the customer | Text id |
| `effective_date` | Date the discount change takes effect; recorded as the effective date of the charge | YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, no time zone |
| `restated_term_premium` | Annual premium the policy carries once the discount has stopped | USD with 2 decimal places, already rounded half-up to the cent |
| `amount` | Additional premium charged for the stop | USD with 2 decimal places, a positive figure already rounded half-up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new premium account entry reference, the amount charged in USD with 2 decimal places, its effective date, the restated annual premium and the premium balance now owed. Receiving it means the charge is posted; afterwards the new charge is visible on the premium account, together with the higher balance and the restated annual premium on the policy.

## Points of reference

- The entry is an additional premium entry, never a fee entry; its change reason reads multi-policy discount change.
- The date carried by the entry is the closed date of the ending Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy or Larkspur Valuables Floater.
- One stop produces one entry.
